<a id="PurchaseStatesList"></a>

### Available Purchase Statuses
|Status|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`DRAFT`|No data is added to Purchase details.|
|`VOIDED`|Task has been voided|
|`ORDERING`|OrderStatus = `DRAFT`|
|`ORDERED`|OrderStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`RECEIVING`|OrderStatus = `AUTHORISED`, StockReceivedStatus = `DRAFT`|
|`RECEIVED`|StockReceivedStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`INVOICED`|InvoiceStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`CREDITED`|CreditNoteStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`RECEIVING / CREDITED`|Combined Stock Status = `PARTIALLY RECEIVED`, RestockReceivedStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`RECEIVED / CREDITED`|Combined Stock Status = `FULLY RECEIVED`, RestockReceivedStatus = `AUTHORISED`|
|`PARTIALLY INVOICED`|Combined Invoice Status = `PARTIALLY INVOICED`|
|`COMPLETED`|InvoiceStatus = `AUTHORISED`, RestockReceivedStatus = `AUTHORISED`|

## Purchase List

Path: `/purchaseList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Search={Search}&RequiredBy={RequiredBy}&UpdatedSince={UpdatedSince}&OrderStatus={OrderStatus}&RestockReceivedStatus={RestockReceivedStatus}&InvoiceStatus={InvoiceStatus}&CreditNoteStatus={CreditNoteStatus}&UnstockStatus={UnstockStatus}&Status{Status}&DropShipTaskID={DropShipTaskID}`

### Available Fields for Purchase List
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `ID`  | Guid           |         |          |Unique Cin7 Core Purchase identifier          |
| `BlindReceipt`  | Boolean             |         |          |Specifies, if Purchase is a Blind Receipt order (no purchase order)         |
| `OrderNumber`  | String             | 256        |          |Purchase Order number generated by Cin7 Core         |
| `Status`  | String          |  50       |          |Current Purchase status. Current sale status. Possible values are <a href="#PurchaseStatesList"><b>values</b></a>        |
| `OrderDate`  | Date         |         |          | Date when Purchase Order was created        |
| `InvoiceDate`  | Date            |         |          | Date when Invoice was issued       |
| `Supplier`  | Date            | 256        |          | Name of the Supplier        |
| `SupplierID`  | Guid |         |          | Identifier of Supplier.       |
| `InvoiceNumber`  | String |   256      |          | Invoice number issued by Supplier       |
| `InvoiceAmount`  | Decimal |         |          | Total Invoice amount in Supplier currency        |
| `PaidAmount`  | Decimal |         |          | Total Paid amount minus Refunded amount in Supplier currency        |
| `InvoiceDueDate`  | Date |         |          | Date when invoice is due according to selected payment terms         |
| `RequiredBy`  | Date |         |          | Date when shipment is due     |
| `BaseCurrency`  | String | 3        |          | 3 digit Base currency code (as configured in General Settings)        |
| `SupplierCurrency`  | String | 3        |          | 3 digit Supplier currency code       |
| `CreditNoteNumber`  | String | 256        |          | Credit note number issued by Supplier. Is empty unless credit note is created       |
| `OrderStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Purchase Order status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`|
| `StockReceivedStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Purchase stock received status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`        |
| `UnstockStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Invoice status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`      |
| `InvoiceStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Purchase unstock status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`   |
| `CreditNoteStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Credit Note status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`       |
| `LastUpdatedDate`  | Date |         |          | Date and time when purchase task was created of last time modified    |
| `CombinedReceivingStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Combined Put Away status. Possible Values are `FULLY RECEIVED`, `PARTIALLY RECEIVED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `NOT RECEIVED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `CombinedInvoiceStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Combined Invoice status. Possible Values are `INVOICED`, `INVOICED / CREDITED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `NOT INVOICED`, `PARTIALLY INVOICED`, `PARTIALLY INVOICED / CREDITED`        |
| `CombinedPaymentStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Payment status. Possible Values are `PREPAID`, `PARTIALLY PAID`, `UNPAID`, `PAID`, `OVERPAID / CREDITED`, `VOIDED`       |
| `Type`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Type of Purchase. Possible Values are `Simple Purchase`, `Advanced Purchase` , `Service Purchase`        |
| `IsServiceOnly`  | Boolean             |         |          |Specifies, if Purchase is a `Service Purchase`         |
| `DropShipTaskID`  | Guid             |         |          |ID of sale which created drop ship pruchase         |

<a id="get-purchaselist"></a>
### GET /purchaseList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Search={Search}&RequiredBy={RequiredBy}&UpdatedSince={UpdatedSince}&OrderStatus={OrderStatus}&RestockReceivedStatus={RestockReceivedStatus}&InvoiceStatus={InvoiceStatus}&CreditNoteStatus={CreditNoteStatus}&UnstockStatus={UnstockStatus}&Status{Status}&DropShipTaskID={DropShipTaskID}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Search` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with search value contained in one of these fields: OrderNumber, Status, Supplier, InvoiceNumber, CreditNoteNumber
- `RequiredBy` (optional, DateTime): Only return purchase orders with Required By date on or before specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `UpdatedSince` (optional, DateTime): Only return purchase changed after specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `UpdatedUntil` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales changed before specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `OrderStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified order status
- `RestockReceivedStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified stock received (put away) status
- `InvoiceStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified invoice status
- `CreditNoteStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified credit note status
- `UnstockStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified unstock status
- `Status` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified purchase status
- `DropShipTaskID` (optional, Guid): Only return drop ship purchase which was created by specified sale task ID

<a id="get-purchasecreditnotelist"></a>
### GET /purchaseCreditNoteList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Search={Search}&UpdatedSince={UpdatedSince}&CreditNoteStatus={CreditNoteStatus}&Status{Status}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Search` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with search value contained in one of these fields: OrderNumber, Status, Supplier, InvoiceNumber, CreditNoteNumber
- `UpdatedSince` (optional, DateTime): Only return purchase changed after specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `UpdatedUntil` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales changed before specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `CreditNoteStatus` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified credit note status
- `Status` (optional, string): Only return purchase orders with specified purchase status

## Purchase

Path: `/purchase`

+ This endpoint is deprecated and supports only Simple Purchases. Please use <a href="#AdvancedPurchase">`Advanced Purchase`</a>
 endpoint.

### Available Fields for Purchase
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid|||Unique Cin7 Core Purchase ID|
|`SupplierID`|Guid|||Identifier of Supplier|
|`Supplier`|String|256||Supplier name|
|`Contact`|String|256||Supplier Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Supplier Contact phone|
|`InventoryAccount`|String|50||Account code used by default for invoice lines when no Inventory account is defined on Product. By default Inventory Control Account is used from account mapping.|
|`BlindReceipt`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no order in the purchase. `False` is default|
|`Approach`|String|10||`INVOICE` for `Invoice  First`, or `STOCK` for `Stock First`|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#PurchaseShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Shipping address|
|`BaseCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of Base Currency defined in General Settings on the moment when Purchase was created.|
|`SupplierCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of Supplier Currency defined in Supplier card at the moment when Supplier is selected for the Purchase.|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Purchase|
|`TaxCalculation`|String|||`Inclusive` or `Exclusive`|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`RequiredBy`|DateTime|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256||Default location to store stock to|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Purchase note|
|`OrderNumber`|String|256||Represents Purchase Order Number|
|`Status`|String|20||Current Purchase status. Current sale status. Possible values are <a href="#PurchaseStatesList"><b>values</b></a>|
|`RelatedDropShipSaleTask`|Guid|||ID of SaleTask this drop-ship purchase is related to.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|||Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Supplier currency unit|
|`LastUpdatedDate`|DateTime|||Date and time when purchase task was created of last time modified|
|`Order`|<a href="#PurchaseOrderModel"><b>Purchase Order Model</b></a>|||Purchase Order|
|`StockReceived`|<a href="#PurchaseStockModel"><b>Purchase Stock Model</b></a>|||Purchased and received items|
|`Invoice`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceModel"><b>Purchase Invoice Model</b></a>|||Purchase Invoice|
|`CreditNote`|<a href="#PurchaseCreditNoteModel"><b>Purchase Credit Note Model</b></a>|||Purchase Credit Note|
|`ManualJournals`|<a href="#PurchaseManualJournalModel"><b>Purchase Manual Journal Model</b></a>|||Purchase Manual Journals|
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Purchase Additional Attributes|
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>|||Purchase Attachments|
|`InventoryMovements`|<a href="#InventoryMovementLineModel"><b>Inventory Movement Line Model</b></a>|||Purchase Inventory Movements|

+ All Objects that contain field 'ProductID', also contain additional fields.

### Additional fields
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ProductLength`|Decimal|||Length of product|
|`ProductWidth`|Decimal|||Width of product|
|`ProductHeight`|Decimal|||Height of product|
|`ProductWeight`|Decimal|||Weight of product|
| `WeightUnits`  | String             | 10        |          |Unit of measure for unit weight. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
| `DimensionsUnits`  | String             | 10        |      |Unit of measure for unit length/width/height. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
|`ProductCustomField1`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 1 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField2`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 2 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField3`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 3 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField4`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 4 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField5`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 5 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField6`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 6 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField7`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 7 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField8`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 8 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField9`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 9 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField10`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 10 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|

### Purchase POST/PUT Attributes
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes*|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase ID.Required for PUT|
|`SupplierID`|Guid||Yes*|Identifier of Supplier. Required if Supplier not provided|
|`Supplier`|String|256|Yes*|Supplier name. Required if SupplierID not provided|
|`Contact`|String|256||Supplier Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Supplier Contact phone|
|`BlindReceipt`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no order in the purchase. `False` is default|
|`Approach`|String|10|Yes|`INVOICE` for `Invoice  First`, or `STOCK` for `Stock First`|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#PurchaseShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Shipping address|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Purchase|
|`TaxCalculation`|String|||`Inclusive` or `Exclusive`|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`RequiredBy`|DateTime|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256|Yes|Default location to store stock to|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Purchase note|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|||Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Supplier currency unit|
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Purchase Additional Attributes|

## Purchase Order

Path: `/purchase/order`

### Available Fields for Purchase Order
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Task ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`Memo`|String|1024|Yes|Additional information for Order|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Order Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#PurchaseOrderLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Order Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#PurchaseAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Purchase Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|

<a id="get-purchase-order"></a>

<a id="post-purchase-stock"></a>
### POST /purchase/stock
+ POST method will return exception if Order status is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method will return exception if Stock Received status is not - `DRAFT` or `NOT AVAILABLE`
+ POST method will return exception if Purchase `Approach` = `INVOICE` and `InvoiceStatus` is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method is used to add only new stock lines.
+ To Authorize Stock Received, Request with empty lines in payload can be done.
+ If duplicated lines found in one payload, one line with sum quantity will be created.
+ If lines with same Product, location, batch and expiry Date already exist, error will be thrown.

Request body:

```json
{
  "TaskID": "02b08cd2-51d2-41e6-ab97-85bcd13e7136",
  "Status": "DRAFT",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "Date": "2017-12-08T00:00:00",
      "Quantity": 3,
      "ProductID": "c08b3876-89cc-46c4-af52-b77f058fdf81",
      "SKU": "Bread",
      "Name": "Baked Bread",
      "Location": "Main Warehouse",
      "LocationID": "19aeca31-bd49-4fbe-8abd-37a6169cc2cb",
      "Received": false,
      "BatchSN": "PO-00001-1",
      "SupplierSKU": "",
      "ExpiryDate": "2017-11-28T00:00:00",
      "CardID": "3bc7212b-5ff1-4970-9471-1e6d626065c3"
    }
  ]
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "TaskID": "02b08cd2-51d2-41e6-ab97-85bcd13e7136",
  "Status": "DRAFT",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "Date": "2017-12-08T00:00:00",
      "Quantity": 3,
      "ProductID": "c08b3876-89cc-46c4-af52-b77f058fdf81",
      "SKU": "Bread",
      "Name": "Baked Bread",
      "Location": "Main Warehouse",
      "LocationID": "19aeca31-bd49-4fbe-8abd-37a6169cc2cb",

      "BatchSN": "PO-00001-1",

      "ExpiryDate": "2017-11-28T00:00:00",
      "CardID": "a2db08f1-32cd-48e3-b558-a74af15ee53f"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Purchase Invoice

Path: `/purchase/invoice`

+ This endpoint is deprecated and supports only Simple Purchases. Please use <a href="#AdvancedPurchaseInvoice">`Advanced Purchase Invoice`</a>
 endpoint.

### Available Fields for Purchase Invoice
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Task ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`InvoiceDate`|DateTime||Yes|Date when invoice created. Default value is current date, used if not specified.|
|`InvoiceDueDate`|DateTime||Yes|Date until invoice is valid. If not specified, used default value from Terms.|
|`InvoiceNumber`|string|||Invoice Number (auto-generated)|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Invoice Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`, `PAID`. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`InvoiceTotalAmount`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Not required for POST.|
|`InvoiceTotalTaxAmount`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Not required for POST.|

## Purchase Credit Note

Path: `/purchase/creditnote`

+ This endpoint is deprecated and supports only Simple Purchases. Please use <a href="#AdvancedPurchaseCreditNote">`Advanced Purchase Credit Note`</a>
 endpoint.

### Available Fields for Purchase Credit Note
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Task ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`CreditNoteNumber`|string||Yes|Credit Note Number|
|`CreditNoteDate`|DateTime||Yes|Credit Note Date|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Credit Note Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|

|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`Unstock`|<a href="#PurchaseUnStockLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Unstock Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|

## Purchase Payments

Path: `/purchase/payment`

+ This endpoint is deprecated and supports only Simple Purchases. Please use <a href="#AdvancedPurchasePayments">`Advanced Purchase Payments`</a>
 endpoint.

### Available Fields for Purchase Payments
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Task ID.|
|`ID`|GUID||Yes*|Identifier of payment. Available for PUT|
|`Type`|String||Yes|Available values are `PREPAYMENT`,`PAYMENT`,`REFUND`. Available for POST|
|`Reference`|String|||Payment reference number. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Amount`|Decimal with up to 2 decimal places||Yes|Payment amount in customer currency. Available for POST/PUT. For PUT is not available when payment is a deposit.|
|`DatePaid`|DateTime||Yes|Date when payment has been made. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Account`|String||Yes|Account Code of the bank/payment account from Chart of accounts. Available for POST/PUT. For PUT is not available when payment is a deposit.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Currency Conversion rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Customer currency unit. Available for POST/PUT|
|`DateCreated`|DateTime|||Date of creation payment record.|
|`DepositID`|GUID||No|Identifier of deposit. Available for POST. The payment is taken from deposit if it is specified. Can be used only with Type=`PAYMENT`.|

+ Payments available only for purchase tasks with authorised invoice.

+ Refunds available only for purchase tasks with authorised credit note.

Parameters:

## Advanced Purchase

Path: `/advanced-purchase`
<a id="AdvancedPurchase"></a>

+ This endpoint supports Simple Purchases, Advanced Purchases and Service Purchases.
+ Service Purchases contain additional charges only. All get methods for service purchases will return empty Lines and filled Additional Lines
if `CombineAdditionalCharges` is set to false. POST AND PUT methods work as usual - you can pass Lines and Additional charges, and
they will be converted to Additional charges.

### Available Fields for Purchase
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid|||Unique Cin7 Core Purchase ID|
|`SupplierID`|Guid|||Identifier of Supplier|
|`Supplier`|String|256||Supplier name|
|`Contact`|String|256||Supplier Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Supplier Contact phone|
|`InventoryAccount`|String|50||Account code used by default for invoice lines when no Inventory account is defined on Product. By default Inventory Control Account is used from account mapping.|
|`BlindReceipt`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no order in the purchase. `False` is default|
|`Approach`|String|10||`INVOICE` for `Invoice  First`, or `STOCK` for `Stock First`|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#PurchaseShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Shipping address|
|`BaseCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of Base Currency defined in General Settings on the moment when Purchase was created.|
|`SupplierCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of Supplier Currency defined in Supplier card at the moment when Supplier is selected for the Purchase.|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Purchase|
|`TaxCalculation`|String|||`Inclusive` or `Exclusive`|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`RequiredBy`|DateTime|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256||Default location to store stock to|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Purchase note|
|`OrderNumber`|String|256||Represents Purchase Order Number|
|`OrderDate`|DateTime|||Represents Purchase Order Date|
| `CombinedReceivingStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Combined Put Away status. Possible Values are `FULLY RECEIVED`, `PARTIALLY RECEIVED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `NOT RECEIVED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `CombinedInvoiceStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Combined Invoice status. Possible Values are `INVOICED`, `INVOICED / CREDITED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `NOT INVOICED`, `PARTIALLY INVOICED`, `PARTIALLY INVOICED / CREDITED`        |
| `CombinedPaymentStatus`  | String | 20        |         | Payment status. Possible Values are `PREPAID`, `PARTIALLY PAID`, `UNPAID`, `PAID`, `OVERPAID / CREDITED`, `VOIDED`       |
| `Type`  | String | 20        |         | Type of Purchase. Possible Values are `Simple Purchase`, `Advanced Purchase` , `Service Purchase`        |
| `IsServiceOnly`  | Boolean             |         |          |Specifies, if Purchase is a `Service Purchase`         |
|`Status`|String|20||Current Purchase status. Current sale status. Possible values are <a href="#PurchaseStatesList"><b>values</b></a>|
|`RelatedDropShipSaleTask`|Guid|||ID of SaleTask this drop-ship purchase is related to.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|||Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Supplier currency unit|
|`LastUpdatedDate`|DateTime|||Date and time when purchase task was created of last time modified|
|`Order`|<a href="#PurchaseOrderModel"><b>Purchase Order Model</b></a>|||Purchase Order|
|`StockReceived`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchaseStockModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Stock Model</b></a>|||Purchased and received items. The field is filled only for Advanced Purchases.|
|`PutAway`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchasePutAwayModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Put Away Model</b></a>|||Purchased and put away items|
|`Invoice`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchaseInvoiceModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Invoice Model</b></a>|||Purchase Invoice|
|`CreditNote`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchaseCreditNoteModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Credit Note Model</b></a>|||Purchase Credit Note|
|`ManualJournals`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchaseManualJournalModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Manual Journal Model</b></a>|||Purchase Manual Journals|
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Purchase Additional Attributes|
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>|||Purchase Attachments|
|`InventoryMovements`|<a href="#InventoryMovementLineModel"><b>Inventory Movement Line Model</b></a>|||Purchase Inventory Movements|

+ All Objects that contain field 'ProductID', also contain additional fields.

### Additional fields
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ProductLength`|Decimal|||Length of product|
|`ProductWidth`|Decimal|||Width of product|
|`ProductHeight`|Decimal|||Height of product|
|`ProductWeight`|Decimal|||Weight of product|
| `WeightUnits`  | String             | 10        |          |Unit of measure for unit weight. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
| `DimensionsUnits`  | String             | 10        |      |Unit of measure for unit length/width/height. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
|`ProductCustomField1`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 1 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField2`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 2 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField3`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 3 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField4`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 4 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField5`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 5 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField6`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 6 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField7`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 7 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField8`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 8 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField9`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 9 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField10`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 10 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|

### Purchase POST/PUT Attributes

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes*|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase ID.Required for PUT|
|`SupplierID`|Guid||Yes*|Identifier of Supplier. Required if Supplier not provided|
|`Supplier`|String|256|Yes*|Supplier name. Required if SupplierID not provided|
|`Contact`|String|256||Supplier Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Supplier Contact phone|
|`BlindReceipt`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no order in the purchase. `False` is default|
|`Approach`|String|10|Yes|`INVOICE` for `Invoice  First`, or `STOCK` for `Stock First`. For Service Purchases Approach is always `Invoice First`|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#PurchaseShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Purchase Shipping address|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Purchase|
|`TaxCalculation`|String|||`Inclusive` or `Exclusive`|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`RequiredBy`|DateTime|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256|Yes|Default location to store stock to|
|`PurchaseType`|String|||Can be used only in POST. Available values: `Simple` and `Advanced`|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Purchase note|
|`IsServiceOnly`|Boolean|||`True` if purchase is Service-Only Purchase. `False` is for Simple and Advanced purchases|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|||Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Supplier currency unit|
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Purchase Additional Attributes|

## Advanced Purchase Stock Received

Path: `/advanced-purchase/stock`
<a id="AdvancedPurchaseStock"></a>

+ This endpoint is not available for Service Perchases.
+ If POST or PUT methods called for Simple Purchase, this purchase will be converted to Advanced Purchase.
+ This endpoint is applicable only for Advanced Purchases and if `Use Put Away` option set to true in General Settings.

### Available Fields for Purchase Stock Received
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`PurchaseID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Master Task ID|
|`TaskID`|Guid||No|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Stock Receiving Task ID|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Stock Received Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`. For POST and PUT only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchaseStockLineModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Stock Line Model</b></a>||Yes||

- `PurchaseID` (required): Returns detailed info of a particular Purchase Order

<a id="post-advanced-purchase-stock"></a>
### POST /advanced-purchase/stock
+ POST method will return exception if Order status is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method will return exception if Stock Received status is not - `DRAFT` or `NOT AVAILABLE` or `PARTIALLY RECEIVED`
+ POST method will return exception if Purchase `Approach` = `INVOICE` and `InvoiceStatus` is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method is used to add only new stock lines.
+ POST method will create new Stock Receiving Task, if value of `TaskID` is not provided or equals to `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`.
+ To Authorize Stock Received, Request with empty lines in payload can be done.
+ If duplicated lines found in one payload, one line with sum quantity will be created.
+ If lines with same Product, location, batch and expiry Date already exist, error will be thrown.

Request body:

```json
{
  "PurchaseID": "5a7fb526-527a-4229-b331-90b6f5535aab",
  "TaskID": "3320ef94-a7e8-4d81-9588-2a3e14cfca6f",

  "Lines": [
    {
```

<a id="put-advanced-purchase-stock"></a>
### PUT /advanced-purchase/stock
+ PUT method will return exception if Order status is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ PUT method will return exception if Stock Received status is not - `DRAFT` or `NOT AVAILABLE` or `PARTIALLY RECEIVED`
+ PUT method will return exception if Purchase `Approach` = `INVOICE` and `InvoiceStatus` is not - `AUTHORISED`

<a id="post-advanced-purchase-put-away"></a>
### POST /advanced-purchase/put-away
+ POST method will return exception if Order status is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method will return exception if Put Away status is not - `DRAFT` or `NOT AVAILABLE`
+ POST method will return exception if Purchase `Approach` = `INVOICE` and `InvoiceStatus` is not - `AUTHORISED`
+ POST method is used to add only new stock lines.
+ POST method will create new Stock Receiving Task, if value of `TaskID` is not provided or equals to `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000`.
+ To Authorize Put Away, Request with empty lines in payload can be done.
+ If duplicated lines found in one payload, one line with sum quantity will be created.
+ If lines with same Product, location, batch and expiry Date already exist, error will be thrown.

Request body:

```json
{
  "PurchaseID": "5a7fb526-527a-4229-b331-90b6f5535aab",
  "TaskID": "807c3266-157b-4c0d-8131-a3b8e06c0d97",

      "Date": "2018-04-20T00:00:00",
      "Quantity": 9,
      "ProductID": "34d4edc5-d366-4251-82b2-d75e27fe5e9d",
      "SKU": "GB3-White",

}
```

## Advanced Purchase Invoice

Path: `/advanced-purchase/invoice`
<a id="AdvancedPurchaseInvoice"></a>

### Available Fields for Purchase Invoice

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`PurchaseID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Master Task ID|
|`Invoices`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchasePartialInvoiceModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Invoice Model</b></a>||Yes||

### Advanced purchase invoice partial model
<a id="AdvancedPurchasePartialInvoiceModel"></a>

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Invoice Task ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`InvoiceDate`|DateTime||Yes|Date when invoice created. Default value is current date, used if not specified.|
|`InvoiceDueDate`|DateTime||Yes|Date until invoice is valid. If not specified, used default value from Terms.|
|`InvoiceNumber`|string|||Invoice Number (auto-generated)|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Invoice Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`, `PAID`. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`InvoiceTotalAmount`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Not required for POST.|
|`InvoiceTotalTaxAmount`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Not required for POST.|

## Advanced Purchase Credit Note

Path: `/advanced-purchase/creditnote`
<a id="AdvancedPurchaseCreditNote"></a>

### Available Fields for Purchase Credit Note
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`PurchaseID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Master Task ID|
|`CreditNotes`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchasePartialCreditNoteModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Credit Note Model</b></a>||Yes||

### Advanced purchase credit note partial model
<a id="AdvancedPurchasePartialCreditNoteModel"></a>

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Credit Note Task ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`CreditNoteNumber`|string||Yes|Credit Note Number|
|`CreditNoteDate`|DateTime||Yes|Credit Note Date|
|`CreditNoteInvoiceNumber`|string|50|Yes|Invoice Number for Credit Note|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Purchase Credit Note Status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`,`DRAFT`,`AUTHORISED`,`VOIDED`. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#PurchaseInvoiceAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Purchase Invoice Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`Unstock`|<a href="#PurchaseUnStockLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Unstock Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|

## Advanced Purchase Payments

Path: `/advanced-purchase/payment`
<a id="AdvancedPurchasePayments"></a>

### Available Fields for Purchase Payments
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Task ID.|
|`ID`|GUID||Yes*|Identifier of payment. Available for PUT|
|`Type`|String||Yes|Available values are `PREPAYMENT`,`PAYMENT`,`REFUND`. Available for POST|
|`Reference`|String|||Payment reference number. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Amount`|Decimal with up to 2 decimal places||Yes|Payment amount in customer currency. Available for POST/PUT. For PUT is not available when payment is a deposit.|
|`DatePaid`|DateTime||Yes|Date when payment has been made. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Account`|String||Yes|Account Code of the bank/payment account from Chart of accounts. Available for POST/PUT. For PUT is not available when payment is a deposit.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Currency Conversion rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Customer currency unit. Available for POST/PUT|
|`DateCreated`|DateTime|||Date of creation payment record.|
|`DepositID`|GUID||No|Identifier of deposit. Available for POST. The payment is taken from deposit if it is specified. Can be used only with Type=`PAYMENT`.|

+ Payments available only for purchase tasks with authorised invoice.
+ Refunds available only for purchase tasks with authorised credit note.

<a id="get-advanced-purchase-payment"></a>
### GET /advanced-purchase/payment?PurchaseID={PurchaseID}&OrderNumber={OrderNumber}&InvoiceNumber={InvoiceNumber}&CreditNoteNumber={CreditNoteNumber}

Parameters:
- `PurchaseID` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Purchase Payments
- `OrderNumber` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Purchase Payments with Purchase Order Number
- `InvoiceNumber` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Purchase Payments with Invoice Number
- `CreditNoteNumber` (optional): Returns detailed info of a particular Purchase Payments with Credit Note Number

<a id="delete-purchase-payment-advanced-purchase-payments"></a>
### DELETE /purchase/payment?ID={ID}&DeleteAllocation={DeleteAllocation}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required, string): ID of Payment to Delete
- `DeleteAllocation` (optional, boolean): Delete allocated payments (Default = true)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "Success": true
}
```

## Advanced Purchase Manual Journals

Path: `/advanced-purchase/manualJournal`

### Available field for Purchase Manual Journal
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`PurchaseID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Master Task ID|
|`ManualJournals`|<a href="#AdvancedPurchasePartialMAnJModel"><b>[] Advanced Purchase Manual Journal Model</b></a>||Yes||

### Advanced purchase manual journal partial model
<a id="AdvancedPurchasePartialMAnJModel"></a>

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Purchase Invoice Task ID|
|`Status`|String||Yes|Manual Journal Status. Available values are `NOT AVAILABLE`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`. Available values for POST are `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`|
|`Lines`|<a href="#PurchaseManualJournalLineModel"><b>[] Purchase Manual Journal Line Model</b></a>||||

<a id="get-advanced-purchase-manualjournal"></a>

<a id="post-advanced-purchase-manualjournal"></a>
### POST /advanced-purchase/manualJournal

+ POST can be done even if manual journal status is `AUTHORISED`
+ Line items with IsSystem value = `true` cannot be modified or deleted.

Request body:

```json
{
  "PurchaseID": "5a7fb526-527a-4229-b331-90b6f5535aab",
  "TaskID": "807c3266-157b-4c0d-8131-a3b8e06c0d97",
  "Status": "DRAFT",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "Reference": "",
      "Amount": 20,
      "Date": "2018-04-23T00:00:00",
      "Debit": "715",
      "Credit": "860",
      "IsSystem": false
    }
  ]
}
```
